scientific_scope: Discovery and acquisition-boundary record for independent AFRL/MDF LPBF IN625 process-to-structure evidence. Frontier inclusion does not mean that raw bytes were acquired, that semantics were normalized, or that the source is scientifically comparable to an existing registry record.

authority.repository: Materials Data Facility / Argonne Leadership Computing Facility
authority.dataset_title: AFRL AM Modeling Challenge Series: Challenge 2 Data Package

verified_discovery_claims.repository_description: Calibration, input and supplementary data for prediction of melt-pool geometries as a function of processing conditions.

verified_challenge_q_and_a_constraints.B27_semantics: 2D pad, multiple tracks in one layer

current_access_instructions: Create or use a Globus account.
Join the AFRL Additive Manufacturing Modeling Challenge Series Globus group.
Transfer the Challenge 2 dataset through an authorized Globus endpoint.
acquisition.authorization_boundary: Do not bypass Globus login/group membership and do not fabricate local raw-file identity before transfer.

promotion_plan: Acquire exact Challenge 2 bytes only through an authorized public/Globus route.
SHA-256 bind every transferred archive/file before interpretation.
Inventory all files and preserve exact relative paths, sizes and digests.
Run generic archive, delimited and XLSX structural intake before semantic mapping.
Treat CLI/STL/process-control artifacts as separate evidence classes from measurement tables.
Bind every positive material, machine, process, sample, acquisition, property, unit and method claim to exact source authority evidence.
Use bounded authority-evidence actions for missing claims and preserve exhausted paths.
Preserve single-track, single-layer multi-track and multi-layer wall records as distinct process regimes.
Compare only response-compatible records with existing NIST/Zenodo/Ghosh IN625 evidence; do not pool by alloy name alone.

fallback_candidates_if_transfer_blocked.reason: Small public raw XLSX with independent IN625 coating/neutron-diffraction provenance; scientifically distinct and therefore requires response-specific comparability rather than LPBF pooling.
Large public raw CSV process/sensor/surface-roughness dataset with 27 machining conditions; useful for generic process-to-property autonomy but not LPBF melt-pool comparability.
